reproduction.formula: longitude=(min(node longitude)+max(node longitude))/2; latitude=(min(node latitude)+max(node latitude))/2
reproduction.point_in_polygon_method: Ray crossing against captured complete closed way; confirms this one point only.

primary_property_bridge: The prefecture identifies Ayagawa DC in the former Ayakami Junior High School at Yamada-kami Ko 1180; the municipal reuse page and PDF independently bind the same school/address. OSM way 1166115347 names that former school and is distinct from nearby Ayakami Elementary School. The municipal plan matches the GSI aerial compound through its long central classrooms, northern annex, southeast gym, southwest pool, northeast sports field, and curved west/south access road. No current DC floor or boundary is derived.
precision: Reference point from the OpenStreetMap bounding box of the named former Ayakami Junior High School campus, used only as a parent-property locator. It is not an operator-published DC pin, surveyed centroid, official property boundary, data-center building location or under-gym footprint. Source coordinate digits do not establish ground accuracy.

visual_review.municipal_plan_pdf_page_6: Rendered and viewed: plan explicitly titled 綾上中学校, north arrow up; school central block, northern U-shaped facilities, southeast gym, southwest pool, northeastern playing field and west/south curved road.
visual_review.municipal_pdf_page_7: Rendered and viewed: separate classroom/facility arrangement labels former bicycle parking underneath gym; contextual historical support, not a current data-center plan.
visual_review.gsi_aerial: Viewed all four source tiles; main compound is in 17/114312/52262 with northern continuation in 17/114312/52261. Layout and surrounding road, river and terrain agree with municipal school plan.
visual_review.operator_photo: Viewed exact image captioned Ayagawa Town Data Center: exterior gym and Highreso-marked entrance; no pixel geolocation derived.
visual_review.reason: Aerials corroborate location only; acquisition dates unknown and no physical-status claim made.

root_review: Root reproduced the source bbox midpoint from all 44 closed-ring positions, compared the returned center to 1e-7 degrees and verified containment. Root viewed the municipal plan, GSI aerial compound and operator photo; a separate reviewer independently performed these checks. No DC footprint, official boundary, ground accuracy or full-campus occupancy is inferred.
